text:
Priya: opened PR to add cert-rotation automation examples and offline mirror checks for private/VPC on-prem installs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6401

Tom: good — can you include a short script for rotating certs in air-gapped sites (rsync from jumpbox + checksum verify)? customers keep asking.

Priya: added a bash snippet using sha256sum and gpg sig verification, plus an example of pushing to offline mirror via scp to bastion.

Wei: add an SDK snippet for Node and Python showing how to configure the SDK to use a custom CA dir and pkcs11 module path. some customers on arm64 had issues with dynamic loader paths.

Marta: paste the Node snippet I pushed:

```
// node config
const client = new Redwood({
  basePath: 'https://local.redwood:8443',
  tls: { caDir: '/opt/redwood/certs' },
  kms: { pkcs11: { modulePath: '/usr/lib64/libhsm.so' } }
});
```

Sam: for RHEL8/9 mention lib64 vs lib and recommend using absolute path; add ldconfig note for older distros.

Li: security: call out setting umask in rotation script, avoid leaving private keys world-readable; recommend 750 and system account ownership. Also add note about PKCS#11 PIN entry UX — suggest using a pinfile with proper perms or interactive prompt.

Priya: added umask 027 and example systemd-run wrapper to prompt for PIN at boot for HSM-backed keys.

Alex: link-check flagged vendor quickstart URL. Replace with docs.redwood proxy and add vendor-contact fallback.

deploy-bot: link-check started for PR #6401

deploy-bot: link-check: transient failure for https://vendor.example.com/hsm/quickstart (403). Adding proxy fixed it.

Priya: also added offline install preflight: verify offline bundle checksums, ensure apt/yum repo mirror contains openssl, libssl and pkcs11 driver package names for common distros.

Tom: add an FAQ line: "What if my HSM vendor provides different library name on ARM?" — answer: check vendor package and set absolute module_path; include example for aarch64 '/usr/lib64/aarch64-linux-gnu/libhsm.so'

Sam: LGTM. approving infra.

Li: security ack after wording tightened.

Priya: merging and will cherry-pick to v1-maintenance and post summary in #solutions-eng. Thanks all.
